G1152.name: Damaris
G1152.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G1152.brief: Woman who believed Paul's message in Athens
G1152.short: Damaris was a woman who believed Paul's message in Athens and joined him.

G1149.name: Dalmatia
G1149.brief: Region on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea.
G1149.short: Dalmatia, a region in Illyricum where Titus traveled (<ref="2Ti.4.10">2Ti.4.10</ref>).

G1179.name: Decapolis
G1179.brief: A group of ten Hellenistic cities in ancient Palestine.
G1179.short: The Decapolis was a group of ten Hellenistic cities located in ancient Palestine, mentioned in the New Testament.

G1190.name: Derbe
G1190.brief: City in Lycaonia visited by Paul on missionary journeys.
G1190.short: Derbe, a city in Lycaonia, was visited by Paul during his missionary journeys.

G1115.name: Golgotha
G1115.brief: The place where Jesus was crucified, meaning "Place of a Skull."
G1115.short: Golgotha, also known as the Place of a Skull, was the site outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified (<ref="Matthew 27:33; Mrk.15.22; Luke 23:33; Jhn.19.17">Matthew 27:33; Mrk.15.22; Luke 23:33; Jhn.19.17</ref>).
